stock.description: Standard Development Group Limited is an investment holding company that engages in construction and engineering-related businesses in Mainland China and Hong Kong. It provides interior fitting-out, renovation, alteration, and addition services for residential, industrial, and commercial properties. The company also operates in petroleum, farming, and bio-energy business segments.
